The rate range shown for the Tailored variable rate with offset home loan is an estimate only and is based on a loan amount of $750,000 or more. The rate we offer you in the range will depend on your individual circumstances, including (but not limited to) your banking history with NAB, information provided in your application, loan amount, your credit risk and your credit history. This rate could change and may be different on the day of settlement.
